supplements.title: Effects of different types of physical exercise on postoperative mental health in cancer patients.
supplements.summary: Physical exercise after cancer surgery significantly improves mental health, with yoga most effective for anxiety and aerobic exercise best for quality of life.

supplements.title: Exercise and Mind-Body Interventions for Cancer-Related Fatigue: A Network Meta-Analysis With Exploratory Moderator Analyses.
supplements.summary: Exercise and mind-body interventions effectively reduce cancer-related fatigue, with benefits varying based on patient characteristics and treatment dose.

supplements.title: Physical activity, sedentary behaviour, and anthropometric profiles in women with and without insulin resistance: a cross-sectional study.
supplements.summary: Regular physical activity improves insulin sensitivity in young women, with effects linked to body composition and lifestyle factors.

supplements.title: Variability of the prognostic nutritional index within 3 months after curative resection for non-small cell lung cancer and 2-year recurrence-free survival.
supplements.summary: Changes in nutritional status within three months after lung cancer surgery better predict which patients will have cancer recurrence.

supplements.title: Traditional Chinese medicine formula Xiang Bei San suppresses the growth and metastasis of breast cancer by regulating macrophage polarization and tumor vascularization.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese medicine formula Xiang Bei San suppresses breast cancer growth and spread by shifting immune cells and reducing tumor blood vessel formation.

supplements.title: Targeting C/EBPβ/SCD1/C16:1 loop-driven macrophage M2 polarization by Bruceine D improves anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in colorectal cancer.
supplements.summary: Bruceine D enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in colorectal cancer by blocking immune cells that suppress tumor-fighting responses.

supplements.title: Anti-inflammatory and antinociceptive properties of Handroanthus heptaphyllus (Vell.) Mattos hydroethanolic extract bark in mice.
supplements.summary: Ipê-roxo tree bark extract reduces inflammation and pain in mice by lowering inflammatory molecules, supporting traditional medicinal use.

supplements.title: Shikimic acid ameliorates immobilization-induced muscle atrophy through regulation of inflammation and muscle protein homeostasis.
supplements.summary: Shikimic acid, a plant compound, prevents muscle loss from immobilization by reducing inflammation and restoring protein balance in muscles.

supplements.title: Radiosensitizing effect of astaxanthin on radiation-induced cytotoxicity in breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Astaxanthin, a natural compound, enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in breast cancer cells while potentially reducing needed radiation doses.

supplements.title: In vitro antitumor efficacy of hyaluronic acid coating for curcumin-loaded zeolitic imidazole frameworks-8 (ZIF-8) versus that of uncoated curcumin-loaded ZIF-8 nanocomposites.
supplements.summary: Hyaluronic acid-coated nanoparticles carrying curcumin killed liver and breast cancer cells more effectively than uncoated versions with minimal harm to healthy cells.

supplements.title: Integrative single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analysis reveals a baicalein-responsive 10-gene signature for non-small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified a 10-gene signature showing how baicalein, a natural compound, affects non-small cell lung cancer cells and their environment.

supplements.title: Impact of glycosylation position on flavonoid isomers' inhibition of breast cancer-associated enzyme CYP1B1.
supplements.summary: Mangiferin, a natural flavonoid, inhibits a breast cancer-related enzyme 100-fold more effectively than its chemical isomer by altering sugar attachment position.

supplements.title: Veratramine induces cardiac developmental defects in zebrafish embryos via regulating the Wnt signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Veratramine, a plant alkaloid, damages heart development in zebrafish by activating Wnt signaling and causing oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Bioactivity-guided isolation of cytotoxic constituents from the resin of Aquilaria sinensis.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified four compounds from Aquilaria sinensis resin that effectively kill multiple cancer cell types and reduce inflammation.

supplements.title: Sparingly PEGylated Adipate Copolymers via Enzymatic Synthesis as Nano-Carriers for Solid Dispersions.
supplements.summary: Researchers created biodegradable nanoparticles with reduced PEG that safely deliver curcumin, showing promise for breast cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Fenofibrate attenuates hyperhomocysteinemia-potentiated thrombosis by restoring platelet fatty acid β-oxidation.
off_label.summary: Fenofibrate restores a metabolic pathway in platelets, reducing dangerous blood clots caused by high homocysteine levels.

off_label.title: High intrapancreatic fat deposition accelerates pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma growth and metastasis with enrollment of FABP5 upregulation.
off_label.summary: High fat deposits in the pancreas accelerate pancreatic cancer growth and spread through a protein called FABP5, which could be a new treatment target.

off_label.title: Predictors of clomiphene citrate response in the treatment of men with testosterone deficiency.
off_label.summary: Researchers are working to identify which men with low testosterone will respond well to clomiphene citrate treatment.

off_label.title: Rho-associated kinase inhibitors in cerebral cavernous malformations: a preclinical systematic review.
off_label.summary: ROCK inhibitors, particularly fasudil, reduce harmful iron buildup and lesion formation in preclinical mouse models of cerebral cavernous malformations.

off_label.title: Repurposing atorvastatin for uterine leiomyosarcoma: mevalonate pathway inhibition yields preclinical antitumor efficacy.
off_label.summary: Atorvastatin, a common cholesterol drug, slows uterine leiomyosarcoma growth by blocking a cancer cell survival pathway in lab and animal studies.

off_label.title: Lysosome-targeted copper-modulated carbon dots with near-infrared fluorescence imaging and enhanced photodynamic therapy effects.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed copper-enhanced carbon dots that improve photodynamic therapy effectiveness for cancer treatment through targeted lysosome delivery and enhanced imaging.

off_label.title: Cancer-associated and non-neoplastic fibrosis: Comparative mechanisms and emerging antifibrotic strategies.
off_label.summary: Fibrosis in tumors like pancreatic and breast cancer promotes drug resistance; new antifibrotic therapies targeting fibroblasts could improve treatment outcomes.

off_label.title: Repurposing COVID-19 (and other) mRNA vaccines to boost cancer immunotherapy efficacy: mechanistic insights and future directions.
off_label.summary: COVID-19 mRNA vaccines can be repurposed to enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness by strengthening immune responses against tumors.

off_label.title: Severe hypertriglyceridemia induced by everolimus in a lung transplant patient: Case report.
off_label.summary: Everolimus, used after lung transplants to protect kidneys, can dangerously raise triglyceride levels and increase pancreatitis risk.

off_label.title: 4-methylumbelliferone attenuates amyloid pathology and learning deficits in the APP/PS1 mouse model
off_label.summary: 4-Methylumbelliferone reduces amyloid buildup and improves memory in Alzheimer's disease mouse models.

off_label.title: GPI promotes immunosuppression in anaplastic thyroid carcinoma via O-GlcNAcylated THBS1-mediated myeloid cell crosstalk.
off_label.summary: GPI drives immunosuppression in anaplastic thyroid cancer; blocking it with Regorafenib combined with immunotherapy restores anti-tumor immunity.

off_label.title: IQGAP3 bridges matrix stiffness with glioma stem cell maintenance and radioresistance by stabilizing SOX2.
off_label.summary: Stiff tumor tissue promotes glioblastoma stem cells' resistance to radiation by stabilizing SOX2 protein; blocking this process restores radiation sensitivity.

off_label.title: Impact of Concomitant Proton Pump Inhibitor Use on Oncologic Outcomes of Neoadjuvant Chemoimmunotherapy in Locally Advanced Gastric Cancer: A Multicenter Real-World Study.
off_label.summary: Proton pump inhibitors may reduce the effectiveness of chemotherapy and immunotherapy in treating advanced gastric cancer.

off_label.title: Sigma-1 Receptor antagonism potentiates siramesine-induced apoptosis and altered autophagic signaling in human leukemia cells.
off_label.summary: Blocking sigma-1 receptors enhances siramesine's cancer-killing effects in leukemia cells by boosting apoptosis and autophagy.

off_label.title: Lapatinib Suppressed the Expression of Proinflammatory Cytokines and Alleviated Pain Behavior in a Mouse Model of Postoperative Pain
off_label.summary: Lapatinib, an anticancer drug, reduced inflammation and pain after surgery in mice without opioid-like dependence risks.

biomarkers.title: Stattic administration plays a protective role in a lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury cell model.
biomarkers.summary: Stattic, a Stat3 inhibitor, reduces inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death in lung injury models by blocking the Jak1/Stat3 pathway.

biomarkers.title: Postoperative stimulated thyroglobulin and the ps-tg/TSH ratio enhance the 2025 ATA risk stratification for predicting radioiodine response in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Postoperative thyroglobulin levels improve prediction of treatment success in papillary thyroid cancer using the updated ATA risk classification system.

biomarkers.title: CA7 overexpression enhances the anti-tumor effects of propofol in colorectal cancer via JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
biomarkers.summary: CA7 protein boosts propofol's anti-tumor effects in colorectal cancer by blocking the JAK2/STAT3 growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: EpCAM promotes metastasis-associated phenotypes in Ewing sarcoma-family tumor cells by activating the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: EpCAM protein promotes Ewing sarcoma spread by activating a cellular growth pathway called PI3K/AKT.

biomarkers.title: Sweet syndrome with reactive lymphadenopathy mimicking metastatic disease in an SDHB-mutated abdominal paraganglioma.
biomarkers.summary: Sweet syndrome resolved after surgical removal of an SDHB-mutated paraganglioma, confirming the tumor's paraneoplastic skin manifestation.

biomarkers.title: Hyperthyroidism, acromegaly, and hyperprolactinemia in a patient with a mature plurihormonal PIT-1 lineage adenoma.
biomarkers.summary: A rare pituitary tumor secreting multiple hormones was successfully removed, resolving thyroid and prolactin problems but requiring ongoing monitoring for growth hormone.

biomarkers.title: mRNA delivery of a class 1/4 SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody protects against diverse sarbecoviruses in a lethal mouse challenge model.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers delivered a broadly neutralizing antibody via mRNA to protect mice against multiple coronavirus variants and related bat viruses.

biomarkers.title: Programmable DNA hydrogels for dual-mode PD-L1 suppression via polyvalent LYTAC mimics and transcriptional silencing.
biomarkers.summary: A programmable DNA hydrogel degrades and silences PD-L1 in melanoma, enhancing immune checkpoint blockade and preventing tumor recurrence.

biomarkers.title: Alpha-2 antiplasmin deficiency: a rare fibrinolytic disorder identified after decades of diagnostic delay.
biomarkers.summary: A woman's decades-long bleeding disorder was finally diagnosed as rare alpha-2 antiplasmin deficiency, revealing that standard blood tests miss this fibrinolytic condition.

biomarkers.title: Endothelin-1 overexpression in mice increases vascular Vegfa164 and Vegfa188 alternative splice isoforms via enhanced Khdrbs3 expression.
biomarkers.summary: Endothelin-1 overexpression in blood vessels causes harmful changes by altering how genes produce proteins that promote blood vessel growth.

biomarkers.title: Teaching NeuroImage: Cervical Myelopathy Due to Alveolar Spinal Echinococcosis Cysts.
biomarkers.summary: A spinal infection from parasitic cysts, not cancer recurrence, caused a patient's neck weakness and required surgery plus medication for cure.

biomarkers.title: Standardized ready-to-use natural deep eutectic solvent-impregnated polypropylene fiber units for robust and high-throughput determination of tyrosine kinase inhibitors in biological fluids.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed eco-friendly fiber units for faster, easier measurement of cancer drug levels in patient blood samples.

biomarkers.title: A colorimetric/fluorescent/electrochemical tri-modal biosensor based on dual CRISPR/Cas12a system for detection of microRNA.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a multi-signal biosensor using CRISPR technology to detect cancer microRNA biomarkers more accurately and reliably.

biomarkers.title: Chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy induces complete remission in a patient with concurrent CLL with CNS involvement and multiple sclerosis.
biomarkers.summary: CAR T-cell therapy cured a patient's chronic lymphocytic leukemia and improved their multiple sclerosis simultaneously.

biomarkers.title: Menin inhibitors for patients with relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML): a systematic review and meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Menin inhibitors alone or combined with other drugs show promise for treating relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia, with combination therapy producing higher response rates.

trials.title: Efficacy and Safety of Electroacupuncture for Postoperative Insomnia in Patients With Spinal Metastasis: Protocol of a Prospective, Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Study.
trials.summary: Researchers will test whether electroacupuncture helps spinal cancer patients sleep better after surgery.

trials.title: Development of a pandemic H5N1 influenza vaccine using MDCK suspension cells: A scalable and efficient production platform.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a scalable cell-based method to rapidly produce H5N1 flu vaccine in large bioreactors, achieving high virus yields and strong immune responses.

trials.summary: Postoperative thyroglobulin levels improve prediction of treatment success in papillary thyroid cancer using the updated ATA risk classification system.

trials.title: Sex-based inequities in non-small cell lung cancer: gaps and opportunities across the care pathway.
trials.summary: Women with lung cancer face significant treatment and survival gaps compared to men, driven by both biological and healthcare system barriers.

trials.title: TKI-associated proteinuria and nephrotic syndrome: a narrative review with clinical illustration in radio-iodine-refractory thyroid cancer.
trials.summary: Thyroid cancer drugs called TKIs can cause serious kidney damage, a side effect doctors should watch for more carefully.

trials.title: [18F] PSMA-3Q PET/CT radiomics at 45% SUVmax threshold: predicting post-surgical ISUP grade ≥ 4 and extraprostatic extension for noninvasive stratification in prostate cancer management.
trials.summary: A PET imaging method using radiomics at 45% threshold predicts aggressive prostate cancer grade and spread without surgery.

trials.title: Advanced cystic lung cancer complicated with pulmonary lymphangitic carcinomatosis: a case report.
trials.summary: Advanced lung adenocarcinoma with lymphatic spread was treated with surgery, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy, achieving 41-month survival.

trials.title: Effects of online advance care planning (ACP) decision aid programmes on adults with cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Online tools help cancer patients plan their end-of-life care by improving participation in advance care planning discussions.
